text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from 102,134 to 96,779 overall, so I should take the risk of further losses seriously.","A few months of price changes are not enough to reliably predict what comes next; I should avoid reacting impulsively to short-term moves.","Because I need these savings for retirement and value stability, I should review my holdings and make deliberate, cautious decisions rather than simply leaving them unchecked."]}
